## ShipmentTracker — Blazor Web App (Auto render mode)

| Feature | Details |
|---|---|
| **Render mode** | `InteractiveAuto` — Server on first load, WASM after download |
| **Auth** | ASP.NET Identity with **Dispatcher** and **Customer** roles |
| **Database** | SQLite with EF Core, seeded with 8 sample shipments |

### Pages
- **`/`** — Public shipment tracking by tracking number (e.g. `TRK-10001`)
- **`/dispatcher`** — Dispatcher dashboard: search, filter, update shipment status (Dispatcher role)
- **`/my-shipments`** — Customer view: see own shipments with ETA countdown (Customer role)

### API Endpoints
- `GET /api/shipments` — All shipments (Dispatcher)
- `PUT /api/shipments/{id}/status` — Update status (Dispatcher)
- `GET /api/shipments/track/{trackingNumber}` — Public tracking
- `GET /api/shipments/my` — Customer's shipments

### Navigation
Role-aware sidebar shows relevant links per user role. Run with `dotnet run --project ShipmentTracker/ShipmentTracker`.
